## 🎯 I want to…

Each stack is an ordered recipe. The tool shown is a good default for that step; open the stack on the website to see the alternatives.

| Goal | Recommended path |
|:--|:--|
| 📚 **[Chat with my documents](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=rag)** | Parse files: [Docling](https://docling-project.github.io/docling/) → Embed: [Sentence Transformers](https://sbert.net/) → Store: [pgvector](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector) → Retrieve + answer: [LlamaIndex](https://www.llamaindex.ai/) → Evaluate: [Ragas](https://docs.ragas.io/) |
| 🤖 **[Build an AI agent](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=agent)** | Pick a framework: [Claude Agent SDK](https://docs.claude.com/en/api/agent-sdk/overview) → Give it tools: [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/) → Add memory: [Mem0](https://mem0.ai/) → Run code safely: [E2B](https://e2b.dev/) → Trace & evaluate: [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/) |
| 🔌 **[Connect AI to my app (MCP)](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=mcp)** | Learn the spec: [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) → Build a server: [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/) → Debug it: [MCP Inspector](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/tools/inspector) → Publish: [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/) → Or reuse one: [GitHub MCP Server](https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server) |
| 🎨 **[Design & build a website with AI](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=design)** | Find a direction: [Google Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/) → Design → code: [Figma MCP Server](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/) → Components: [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/) → Build it: [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) → Add motion: [genjutsu](https://genjutsu.athevon.dev/) → See & fix it: [Chrome DevTools MCP](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp) |
| 🏠 **[Run LLMs on my own machine](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=local)** | Get a runtime: [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) → Add a chat UI: [Open WebUI](https://openwebui.com/) → Find models: [Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/) → Serve at scale: [vLLM](https://docs.vllm.ai/) |
| 💻 **[Code faster with AI](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=coding)** | Terminal agent: [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) → AI editor / IDE: [Cursor](https://cursor.com/) → Open-source + your own key: [Cline](https://cline.bot/) → Better context: [Context7](https://context7.com/) |
| 📊 **[Test & monitor my LLM app](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=eval)** | Offline evals in CI: [promptfoo](https://www.promptfoo.dev/) → Tracing: [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/) → Guardrails: [Llama Guard](https://www.llama.com/trust-and-safety/) → Red-team: [garak](https://garak.ai/) |
| 🎙️ **[Build a voice agent](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=voice)** | Orchestrate: [LiveKit Agents](https://docs.livekit.io/agents/) → Speech to text: [faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) → Think fast: [Groq](https://groq.com/) → Text to speech: [ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io/) |
| 🌐 **[Let AI read & use the web](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=web)** | Read pages: [Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev/) → Search: [Tavily](https://www.tavily.com/) → Click & type: [Browser Use](https://browser-use.com/) |
| 🎯 **[Fine-tune an open model](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=finetune)** | Pick a base model: [Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/) → Train: [Unsloth](https://unsloth.ai/) → Track runs: [Weights & Biases](https://wandb.ai/) → Serve it: [vLLM](https://docs.vllm.ai/) |
| 🧰 **[Automate work with AI, no code](https://vivekanand30.github.io/ai-atlas/#stack=nocode)** | Automate workflows: [n8n](https://n8n.io/) → Internal AI apps: [Dify](https://dify.ai/) |

| Tool | Why it's on the list | Pricing | GitHub |

| **[Claude](https://claude.ai/)** | Excellent at careful writing, long documents and analysis, and it can use skills and connectors to your tools.<br><sub>Best for: analyze long documents · writing help · build small interactive tools in chat</sub> | 🟡 Free tier |  |
